## Competitor: 歴史チャンネル例 (Japanese history long-form reference)

- Observed positioning: dramatic narrative history essays, 20-40 minutes.
- Title grammar: a concrete artifact/era + a mystery question, e.g. 「〜の正体」.
- Thumbnail: parchment tones, one artifact silhouette, deep red headline.
competitor.writing_dna:
- Open inside a scene at the artifact, then zoom out to the era question.
- Three to five revelations from primary sources; never assert beyond them.
- End by returning to the artifact with its meaning changed.
